items.title: 미 신경혈관 CT AI 소프트웨어 승인
items.excerpt: 미국 Deep Reasoning AI가 신경혈관 CT 스캔 판독 보조 AI 소프트웨어 'NeuroDR'로 FDA 510(k) 허가를 받았다.

items.title: 대구가톨릭대의료원, 무릎관절 수술 후 오심·구토 예측기술 개발
items.excerpt: 대구가톨릭대의료원 연구팀이 AI로 인공무릎관절 수술 후 오심·구토(PONV) 위험을 사전 예측하는 기술을 개발했다.

items.title: 소변검사로 방광질환 감별…정확도 92%
items.excerpt: 서울아산병원·이대목동병원 연구팀이 고감도 바이오마커 검출법과 AI 알고리즘을 결합해 간질성 방광염과 과민성 방광을 소변검사로 최대 92% 정확도로 감별했다.

items.title: GEHC adds lung, aortic stenosis AI tools to Vscan Air
items.excerpt: GE HealthCare added FDA 510(k)-cleared, CE-marked AI tools to its Vscan Air handheld ultrasound: Lung Guidance (non-experts acquired diagnostic-quality 8-zone lung exams 95.2% of the time vs 96.8% for experts) and AutoAS, which flags moderate-to-severe aortic stenosis from two echo views.

items.title: AI platform maintains success in two pediatric imaging pipelines
items.excerpt: Stanford Children's Health deployed an open-source AI platform that processed over 500 pediatric imaging tasks with 99.2% accuracy for bone-length measurement and fetal MRI analysis, per SIIM-CAIMI 2026 findings.

items.title: AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization for childhood brain tumors
items.excerpt: MANTIS combines DNA methylation profiling with artificial neural networks to give individualized, time-dependent survival predictions for children with medulloblastoma and ependymoma, aiming to balance recurrence risk against therapy-induced harm.

items.title: The TEMPO program and the future of digital mental health regulation in the US
items.excerpt: Commentary on the FDA-CMS TEMPO pilot, which lets AI-enabled digital mental health devices commercialize under a quality management system without immediate premarket authorization, as a real-world-data sandbox for US digital health regulation.

items.title: Predicting persistent fever in patients with cancer receiving antibiotics: a machine learning approach
items.excerpt: Machine learning models built on EHR data from two academic hospitals, externally validated, predict which hospitalized cancer patients will still be febrile 48-72 hours after starting IV antibiotics, to inform imaging and antimicrobial escalation decisions.

items.title: Radiology societies weigh in on FDA’s push to regulate generative AI
items.excerpt: Radiology societies submitted comments on the FDA's push to regulate generative AI medical devices, urging that patient safety remain central and that regulatory flexibility be paired with enforceable safeguards.

items.title: Radiologist FDA leader believes generative AI should be evaluated like human docs
items.excerpt: Rick Abramson, MD, director of the FDA's Digital Health Center of Excellence, said generative AI devices may need to be evaluated more like human physicians than like conventional software.

items.title: FDA, CMS look to collaborate with states on health AI
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: FDA and CMS officials say they want to work with states testing AI in clinical settings through regulatory sandboxes, plus moves on shielding doctors from AI liability.

items.title: Partnering with Singapore to bring frontier AI to public health
items.excerpt: Google is opening a research hub in Singapore to deploy MedGemma and AI tools for clinicians and public health under a partnership with the Singapore government.

items.title: Equipping healthcare professionals with practical AI skills
items.excerpt: Google launched a Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate, built by Google clinicians, to train healthcare workers in practical clinical use of AI tools.

items.title: We are failing to acknowledge or respond proportionately to the potential dangers of AI agents
items.excerpt: BMJ piece arguing the OpenAI-agent hack of an Australian government health website shows health systems are failing to respond proportionately to the security dangers of frontier AI agents.

items.title: Looser Health IT Certification Requirements Shift Oversight to Health Systems
items.excerpt: HHS's HTI-5 final rule removes source-attribute transparency requirements for predictive decision support interventions, so hospitals lose a standardized way to evaluate AI tools and must write disclosure, validation and bias testing into procurement contracts.

items.title: 7 Potential Problems with Medicare’s AI Prior Authorization Experiment
items.excerpt: Analysis of seven risks in CMS's WISeR model, which uses AI vendors to screen prior authorization for selected services in traditional Medicare.

items.title: AI, Digital Pathology in Early Breast Cancer Among Highlights at SABCS
items.excerpt: SABCS co-director Virginia Kaklamani says AI-analyzed digital pathology that may match genomic assays in deciding who needs chemotherapy or extended endocrine therapy will be the biggest theme of this year's San Antonio Breast Cancer Symposium.

items.title: ‘Digital twins’ of immune system in pregnancy identify drugs to prevent early labor, Stanford Medicine-led study finds
items.excerpt: Stanford Medicine researchers built AI-enabled 'digital twins' of immune changes in pregnancy and used them to identify existing drugs that could prevent preterm labor.

items.title: AI-Generated Draft Response Tool, Message Turnaround Time, and After-Hours Replies Among Health Care Clinicians
items.excerpt: Across 983,154 replies from 1,542 clinicians at Columbia, using Epic's AI-drafted In Basket replies cut message turnaround time 29.5%, yet overall adoption was linked to an 8.6% rise in turnaround and no overall drop in after-hours messaging.
